thread:
Maya P: Quick kudos — huge thanks to @Aisha and @Ben for stepping in tonight to run live captions and ad-hoc translation during the EU customer demo. They caught the Q&A threading issue and the client left happy. :tada: /kudos @Aisha @Ben
kudos-bot: Added 2 kudos points to @Aisha and 2 kudos points to @Ben. Reason: "live captions + translation rescue" :medal_sports:
Jesse: That was 🔥. Aisha, your captions were spotless. Saved me from frantic typing.
Carlos: Also want to flag Rowan — hopped on to debug the slide deck timing so video and slides didn't drift. Total clutch.
Rowan: AH thanks! Was fun. also 👋 to whoever brought the late-night cookies in the kitchen. lifesaver.
Aisha: lol cookies = morale. Happy to help — was a good team effort. Coffee on me tomorrow for everyone who helped. ☕️
Ben: Thanks! Learned a bit about the caption tool's shortcuts too. If anyone wants the cheat sheet, I'll paste it.
Ben: ```/caption start --lang en --auto-sync
/shortcut toggle-phrase-capture: alt+shift+c
```
Maya P: Love it. @Ben please drop the cheat sheet in #devex later. @PeopleOps we should put a small note in the weekly shoutouts.
Aisha: If kudos-bot wants a proper reason: "kept demo accessible and handled translations on the fly".
Rowan: :clap: :clap:
Hannah: Adding my +1 — super proud of how we rallied.
kudos-bot: Reminder: You can give a formal kudos with `/kudos give @name [reason]` — use it freely! :sparkles:
